title: Newsom Signs SB 925 Directing California Fusion Energy Strategic Plan
detail: On September 30, 2026, Governor Gavin Newsom signed Sen. Jerry McNerney's SB 925 at UC Berkeley, requiring the California Energy Commission to develop a strategic plan to advance fusion energy: expanding R&D, identifying potential power plant sites, and creating licensing, certification and environmental-review pathways. The bill was sponsored by General Atomics. The governor's announcement also included a $30 million investment for quantum and fusion research. Companion bill AB 2647 requires an assessment of advanced nuclear technologies by January 1, 2028.

media.caption: Governor Newsom signs legislation to accelerate California's fusion industry
